unresolved.why: In 2006 the districts of the dissolved Xaisomboun special region went to Vientiane (Hom, Phun, Xaysomboun) and Xiangkhouang (Thathom); the province re-created in 2013 has five districts (Anouvong, Longchaeng, Longxan, Hom, Thathom) whose extent against the 2006–2013 districts is not documented (Longchaeng is new; Statoids only assumes the 2006 borders), so the 2006–2013 outlines of these three provinces are not unions of the 2019 districts as far as can be shown.
